description_en: Changes the resource group of a resource
description_zh: 该接口用于修改资源归属资源组
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public change-resource-manager-resource-group --resource-type project --resource-id test_project --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceManagerResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

project: a workspace. Select this value to change the resource group for a DataWorks edition.

tenantresourcegroup: an exclusive resource group. Select this value to change the resource group for a DataWorks exclusive resource group
parameters.help_zh:
资源的类型，取值如下：
project，工作空间。如果您需要修改的是DataWorks版本所归属的资源组信息时，请选择project。
tenantresourcegroup，独享资源组。如果您需要修改的是DataWorks独享资源组所归属的资源组信息时，请选择tenantresourcegroup
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource. The value of this parameter depends on the value of the ResourceType parameter:

If ResourceType is set to project, this parameter specifies the name of the workspace (ProjectIdentifier). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html operation to obtain the workspace name.

If ResourceType is set to tenantresourcegroup, this parameter specifies the identifier of the exclusive resource group (Identifier). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780075.html operation to obtain the identifier. This applies only to resource groups of type 7, 8, or 9
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型的ID标识符，取值如下：
当ResourceType=project时，则ResourceId可以理解为通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html接口获取工作空间的名称（ProjectIdentifier）。
当ResourceType=tenantresourcegroup时，则ResourceId可以理解为通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780075.html接口获取独享资源组的标识（Identifier）, 仅限ResourceGroupType=7、8、9的类型
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the resource group was changed

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
